longBusinessSummary: TerraVest Industries Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells goods and services in Canada, the United States, and internationally. The company operates in four segments: HVAC and Containment Equipment, Compressed Gas Equipment, Processing Equipment, and Service.
